decisions.decision: Keep vcn-20260812-2153 / subnet-20260812-2149 as the canonical networking; delete the other 9 duplicate/incomplete VCNs
decisions.rationale: Console's 'Create new virtual cloud network' quick-create flow creates the VCN+subnet+IGW as its own step before attempting the instance launch -- every failed manual retry left orphaned networking behind. This one was verified fully wired (route to IGW, SSH open in default security list).

decisions.decision: Use a CLI-scripted retry poller instead of manual console clicking, after 15 manual retries and a rate-limit hit
decisions.rationale: User's explicit choice among three options presented (manual spaced retries / CLI poller / wait-and-check-in-an-hour). Poller reuses the one fixed subnet per attempt rather than recreating networking each time, avoiding the duplicate-VCN problem structurally.

decisions.decision: Install OCI CLI's venv against a freshly winget-installed Python 3.12, not the machine's default Python 3.15-rc or 3.14
decisions.rationale: Both default Pythons are too new for PyYAML's prebuilt Windows wheels, and MSVC Build Tools aren't installed to compile from source. 3.12 has full wheel coverage.

decisions.decision: Personal SSH admin key generated fresh this session (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, passphrase-protected), not the console's 'generate a key pair for me' option
decisions.rationale: Keeps the human's personal admin access separate from the CI deploy key plan 05-05 creates later, per the original plan's explicit instruction.

decisions.decision: Filed the operator's nonprod-environment + Playwright E2E requirement as a new standalone todo rather than folding it into Phase 5

To resume the poller, run this bash loop (adjust the log path if the scratchpad directory differs in the new session): OCI=/c/Users/andre/lib/oracle-cli/Scripts/oci.exe; TENANCY=ocid1.tenancy.oc1..aaaaaaaauc6kfcacyk2cfer7ty5dejrpfhfaz43y5dpkfa5itqeil7aaek3q; AD='lEvc:EU-ZURICH-1-AD-1'; SUBNET=ocid1.subnet.oc1.eu-zurich-1.aaaaaaaaloqcammuivurg6ntefco75aqlw6zct4p2e5cffabqbzvm32u6ufa; IMAGE=ocid1.image.oc1.eu-zurich-1.aaaaaaaaaa4q3dgvx2y25tf7y4zzinqz3xu4xne7pphaesu6ygmssogngv5q; SSHKEY=/c/Users/andre/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub -- then loop "$OCI" compute instance launch --availability-domain "$AD" --compartment-id "$TENANCY" --shape VM.Standard.A1.Flex --shape-config '{"ocpus":2,"memoryInGBs":12}' --subnet-id "$SUBNET" --image-id "$IMAGE" --display-name kanban-backend-prod --assign-public-ip false --ssh-authorized-keys-file "$SSHKEY", classifying 'Out of host capacity' (retry 60s) vs 'TooManyRequests' (retry 120s) vs anything else (stop, real problem). Run it via the harness's own run_in_background:true Bash mechanism, not a manually-detached PowerShell Start-Process -- that gets killed by this session's sandbox when the tool call ends, confirmed by direct observation this session. The OCI CLI's own file-permission-check helper prints harmless Get-Acl/PowerShell.Security module-load errors on every call in this environment; ignore them, they don't affect the actual API result.
